dispositions.evidence: CHIC online access is publisher-provided for private use; the repository preserves only five source-located critical readings on two H-series objects. Bulk republication is not inferred from online availability.
dispositions.next_route: lawful source-specific encoding or independent observation

dispositions.evidence: All 331 catalogue identities and H/I/S/Y denominators are registered. DBAS-CHS provides a lawful metadata research route for seals, but its drawings/photos are not redistributed and its scholarly classifications remain attributed.
Competing transnumerations/sign-repertoire claims require source-located publication evidence; disagreements must be preserved rather than normalized away.
University of Florence DBAS-CHS supports provenance/context/material/shape/sign-position research and explicitly treats graphic/iconographic classification as analytically revisitable.

Mnamon describes the Ecole française d'Athènes online CHIC as providing photographs, facsimiles, normalized transcription and transnumeration for private use; availability is not treated as redistribution permission.

qualification: The representative acquisition target is not fabricated from restricted material. New lawful object-level evidence reopens acquisition.
